name: Piracy Reworked
author: Tristan
description: The black market is pirate infrastructure - and every credit that moves through the underworld is revenue for it. Your smuggling, the sector's own illegal trade, and commissions placed through underworld contacts all feed a pirate war chest that finances raids and new bases. Order goods no legal market sells - stolen from real colonies by real raids. Optionally (off by default), smuggling leaves you a debt rather than a bounty: one compounding balance a collection house buys up and collects fleet-to-fleet, with no pay-off button anywhere. One collector fleet, sized off your own: pay, or destroy every officer aboard and the debt dies with them. Stop paying on terms and your paper gets sold to the pirates, who quote figures they made up. Fading wariness and a closed-loop pirate economy you can starve or bankroll. Standalone. Configurable via LunaLib (optional).
